name: EU AI Act — GPAI Model Obligations
description: Chapter V obligations for general-purpose AI models (Articles 51-55), including systemic-risk models. Informational, not legal advice.

rules.title: Technical documentation
rules.description: Annex XI technical documentation for the GPAI model is drawn up and kept current.

check.question: Is Annex XI technical documentation for the GPAI model drawn up and kept current?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: Produce and maintain the artefact required under Article 53(1)(a).

rules.title: Downstream-provider information
rules.description: Annex XII information and documentation is made available to downstream providers integrating the model.

check.question: Is Annex XII information/documentation made available to downstream providers integrating the model?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: Produce and maintain the artefact required under Article 53(1)(b).

rules.title: Copyright policy
rules.description: A policy is in place to comply with Union copyright law, including Article 4(3) DSM Directive opt-outs.

check.question: Is there a policy to comply with Union copyright law (including Art. 4(3) DSM opt-outs)?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: Produce and maintain the artefact required under Article 53(1)(c).

rules.title: Training-content summary
rules.description: A sufficiently detailed public summary of the content used to train the model is published.

check.question: Is a sufficiently detailed public summary of training content published?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: Produce and maintain the artefact required under Article 53(1)(d).

rules.title: Authorized representative
rules.description: Non-EU providers appoint an EU authorized representative.

check.question: Have non-EU providers appointed an EU authorized representative?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: Produce and maintain the artefact required under Article 54.

rules.title: Model evaluation & adversarial testing
rules.description: For systemic-risk models, model evaluation including adversarial testing is performed and documented.

check.question: For systemic-risk models, is model evaluation incl. adversarial testing performed and documented?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: Produce and maintain the artefact required under Article 55(1)(a).

rules.title: Systemic-risk assessment & mitigation
rules.description: Systemic risks at Union level are assessed and mitigated.

check.question: Are systemic risks at Union level assessed and mitigated?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: Produce and maintain the artefact required under Article 55(1)(b).

rules.title: Serious-incident tracking
rules.description: Serious incidents are tracked, documented, and reported to the AI Office without undue delay.

check.question: Are serious incidents tracked, documented, and reported to the AI Office without undue delay?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: Produce and maintain the artefact required under Article 55(1)(c).

rules.title: Cybersecurity protection
rules.description: Adequate cybersecurity protection for the model and its physical infrastructure is ensured.

check.question: Is adequate cybersecurity protection for the model and its physical infrastructure ensured?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: Produce and maintain the artefact required under Article 55(1)(d).

rules.title: Systemic-risk classification
rules.description: A model with high-impact capabilities (e.g., exceeding 10^25 FLOPs of training compute) is classified as GPAI with systemic risk, triggering Article 55 obligations.

check.question: Does the model have high-impact capabilities / exceed 10^25 FLOPs of training compute (so systemic-risk obligations apply)?
check.evidence_prompt: Link model documentation / policy / evaluation report.

rules.remediation: If yes, comply with the systemic-risk obligations under Article 55 (rules GPAI-06 through GPAI-09).
